summary: Institutional positioning is heavily focused on long-term, massive-scale directional bets on the SPX, characterized by extreme premium accumulation in far-dated LEAPS. Significant conviction is evident in the massive $913.2M and $909.2M buy-side accumulation of the SPX 7000C strikes for 2026 and 2027, balanced by heavy hedging/downside bets in the SPX 8000P strikes. Persistent interest is confirmed by the $3.6B accumulation in the SPX 7000C (exp 2026-07-17) and $2.8B in the SPX 8000P (exp 2026-07-17) over the last three sessions, suggesting a massive "strangle" or volatility play. Traders should watch for continued volatility expansion or massive liquidity shifts in SPX as these multi-billion dollar positions continue to scale into the 2026/2027 expiries.
